snippet.title: Modern History TV
snippet.description: Jason Kingsley CBE, the Modern Knight, explores the real world of the Middle Ages perfect for fantasy fans, writers, gamers, and creators who want to understand the history behind the swords and castles. We aim to research and test out what it was like for both ordinary people, peasants and townspeople, as well as the nobility like knights and lords. Jason owns and trains his own warhorses, jousts competitively, fights in medieval armour and tests theories practically and sometimes to destruction. Mostly about the historical medieval in England, we occasionally venture into other aspects of history and occasionally fantasy like Lord of the Rings or Dungeons and Dragons. We are a historically researched factual channel useful to writers and gamers as well and people interested in historical documentaries. The aim is to provide accurate, engaging, and evergreen history content for students, teachers, writers, role-players, and anyone curious about how medieval life really worked.

snippet.title: George's History
snippet.description:
History has always mattered to me for reasons beyond dates and turning points. What fascinates me is how the past once felt ordinary while it was happening—how people went about their lives without knowing their moment would one day be studied.

Today, I use AI as a visual instrument to help re-create those lost viewpoints. The aim isn’t spectacle or revisionism. It’s perspective. To step back into spaces as they once were and understand history from the inside, not from a textbook summary.

This channel focuses on visual reconstructions that emphasise atmosphere, place, and human scale. Streets, rooms, landscapes—rebuilt carefully to help the past feel less distant and more real.

No shortcuts. No hype.
Just a quieter way of seeing history.
